info.name: Autonomous AP APIs Chart of Accounts Vat API

items.docs: Creates a new Vat master item in AppZen. Returns a uuid for this vat item. When vat item -- with the same vat_code/vat_rate combination -- already exists, then the operation is an update (in this case, the `status` in the response will be `UPDATED`).

params.name: uuid
params.description: Globally unique identifier for an uploaded document

items.docs: Returns the details of a Vat master item by uuid

info.name: Returns Vat master item details by vat-id

items.docs: Returns Vat master item details matching vat-id specified as path parameter

info.name: Returns Vat master item details by vat-code and vat-rate

params.name: vat-rate
params.description: customer vat rate. If vat record was loaded without a vat rate, set it to 0 in this request

items.docs: Returns Vat master item details matching vat-code and vat-rate specified as path parameters
